title: C1 Advanced
description: Precisión, registro formal y estructuras avanzadas

units.title: Inversion for Emphasis
units.description: Usa la inversión negativa para un registro formal y enfático.

content.title: CEO's farewell speech
content.passage: Never have I worked with such a dedicated team. Not only did we double our revenue, but we also opened three new offices. Rarely does a company grow this fast without losing its culture. No sooner had we launched the product than orders started pouring in. Under no circumstances should we forget how we got here.

content.instructions: Analiza el orden de las palabras en el discurso.

items.question: In "Never have I worked…", what comes right after 'Never'?
"Not only did we double…" — why 'did'?
options: Past simple needs the auxiliary 'did' to invert
items.explanation: Si no hay auxiliar, usamos do/does/did para invertir.

items.question: What is the effect of this structure?

content.title: Negative adverbials + inversion
content.explanation: Cuando una expresión negativa o restrictiva abre la frase, el auxiliar va delante del sujeto (como en una pregunta). Si no hay auxiliar, se usa do/does/did. Es propio del registro formal, escrito o de discursos.

rows: Rarely do we see such talent.
Not only did she win, but she also broke the record.
No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.
Under no circumstances should you open it.

examples: Never have I seen such a beautiful view.

content.instructions: Completa con el auxiliar y el sujeto correctos.

items.sentence: No sooner ___ we left than it started to rain.
Under no circumstances ___ you tell anyone.

content.instructions: Reescribe empezando con la expresión dada.
